title: Turnkey bathroom renovation: stages, price and common mistakes
seo_title: Turnkey Bathroom Renovation: Stages, Price, Mistakes
description: How to do a turnkey bathroom renovation in Kyiv without leaks or rework: the stages, what drives the price and what not to economise on.
lead: The bathroom is the most complex room in any renovation: water, electrics, ventilation and tiles all meet here. Here is how a turnkey bathroom renovation goes, what affects the price and which mistakes to avoid.

We give the exact cost of a [bathroom renovation](/en/bathroom-renovation) after measuring and fix it in an estimate with a ±5% guarantee if we do the renovation. If the bathroom is part of an apartment renovation, it is included in the overall price from $550 per m² (works and rough materials).
What you must not economise on

The most expensive bathroom mistakes are hidden: poor waterproofing, wrong falls, no inspection hatches, weak ventilation. Once the tiles are on you cannot see them, and fixing them means tearing everything out. That is why we do these stages strictly by the technology and make a photo report at each one.

We prepare the tile layout before work starts: joints line up with niches, concealed frames and the edges of the mirror, and cuts go into inconspicuous corners. The bathroom looks neat, and tiles are not ordered “with a double margin just in case”.
Bathroom with a marble wall, a built-in bathtub and a backlit countertop — Edelweiss design project
We set the timing in the contract after measuring. Waterproofing and screed need time to dry, so we do not rush these stages — that is what keeps the bathroom leak-free for years.

A bathroom without proper ventilation means condensation, mouldy joints and odours. We check the draught in the shaft, fit a fan with a timer or humidity sensor, and in small bathrooms a non-return valve. Lighting is planned in several scenes — general, at the mirror and in the niches — with the right moisture protection rating.
for the floor — with an anti-slip surface
large format on the walls — fewer joints and easier cleaning
highly moisture-resistant grout in the shower zone
a 5–10% margin for cuts, not “twice as much just in case”

Wall-hung vanities and concealed frames visually free up space and make cleaning easier. We put furniture sizes into the design before tiling so that water outlets and sockets end up exactly where they are needed. Some sanitaryware, furniture and lighting can be brought directly from China — this makes [turnkey procurement](/en/turnkey-procurement) cheaper.

Why do the bathroom together with the apartment design

When the bathroom is part of the [apartment design project](/en/apartment-interior-design), all decisions are coordinated: the tiles match the hallway floor, the lighting matches the other scenes, and the crew works from drawings without rework. A design project starts from $30 per m², with a minimum budget of $2,500.
laying tiles without a layout and ending up with cuts in plain sight
forgetting inspection hatches to meters and valves
installing a shower without a fall or with the drain in the wrong place
choosing mixers after the walls are closed
We fix all these decisions in the design before work starts so that the crew does not decide them on the go. You see in advance how the bathroom will look and know the exact estimate.
faq: How much does a turnkey bathroom renovation cost?
It depends on the area, tiles and sanitaryware. We name the sum after measuring and fix it in an estimate with a ±5% guarantee if we do the renovation.
Do you renovate only a bathroom without the rest of the apartment?
Yes, we take on bathrooms and WCs separately.
Can you make a shower without a tray?
Yes, if the floor height and the fall to the drain allow it; we check this when measuring.
